name: scene3d_remove_object_keyframes
description: Delete object motion: keyframeIds for single poses, or objectIds to stop an object moving entirely (every take, or one with shotId). Idempotent. The object stays in the scene either way — only its motion goes, back to where it stands at t=0. @see guides_get('scene3d')

shotId.description: Limit objectIds to one take. Default: every take.
